notes: data_focus is limited (a 40-case cluster) but the vaccination-group contrasts are set side by side, so comparison is pair with null scale. vaccine_outcome_type is effectiveness because the report characterizes breakthrough infections and investigates reduced VE (waning, cold chain), though no VE is estimated; 'other' is defensible.
